$comment: Proof-of-life spec, written 2026-08-31 against the LIVE Fire page's actual rendered markup (verified via curl, not guessed from memory). Node/Playwright were only just installed on this dev box — see the ap-verification-layer-status memory for status/next-steps.
$comment_noOverlap: Deliberately EMPTY here. .apf-card/.apf-badge__tile/.apf-ln are all `position:absolute !important` by design (the --u design-unit overlay pattern every ap-* hero uses) -- audit-layout.mjs's overlap check only inspects static/relative siblings, so it would silently check zero elements and report a false pass. This IS the real bug class that hit Public Works (a connector line landing under a card, see ap-sector-page-deploys.md) -- audit-layout.mjs cannot catch that yet as written. Needs a follow-up check that measures a configured set of absolutely-positioned 'scene' elements against each other, before this spec's noOverlap is meaningful for any hero section.
